topic: Classifying Substances as Elements and Compounds
key_concepts: Substances are classified into elements and compounds
An element is composed of only one type of atom
Elements cannot be broken down into other substances
There are 118 known elements, with 92 naturally occurring and 26 synthetic
Elements are arranged in the periodic table by increasing atomic number
Jons Jakob Berzelius pioneered the one- and two-letter chemical symbol system
Chemical symbols use the first letter capitalized or first and second letters if needed
Some element symbols come from Latin or Greek names
A compound is made of two or more different atoms joined by chemical bonds
Compounds can be broken down into simpler substances through chemical reactions
Elements and compounds can be distinguished by their composition and chemical formulas
Examples of compounds include water, alcohol, vinegar, sand, and table salt
